Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, O Most Generous in giving
And O Best of those who are asked
And O Most Merciful of those from whom mercy is sought

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ فِيْ الْأَوَّلِينَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family among the first ones

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ فِيْ الْآخِرِينَ
Translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family among the last ones

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ فِيْ الْمَلَاَ الْأَعْلٰى
Translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family in the highest assembly

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ فِيْ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
Translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family among the messengers
O Allah, grant Muhammad and his family
The means, the excellence
The honor and the elevation
And the highest rank
O Allah, I have believed in Muhammad

Arabic text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
Translation: Peace be upon him and his family, though I have not seen him
So do not deprive me of seeing him on the Day of Resurrection
And grant me his companionship
And let me die following his way
And quench my thirst from his fountain
A satisfying drink
Pleasant and wholesome
After which I will never thirst again
Indeed, You have power over all things
O Allah, I have believed in Muhammad

Arabic text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
Translation: Peace be upon him and his family, though I have not seen him
So let me recognize his face in Paradise
O Allah, convey from me to Muhammad
Peace be upon him and his family
Abundant greetings and peace
